newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: Amoco to explore acreage near Trinidad.
newsitem.headline: Amoco to explore acreage near Trinidad.
newsitem.dateline: PORT OF SPAIN, Trinidad and Tobago 1997-01-20

text.p: Amoco Corp said Monday it will look for new sources of oil about 35 miles east of Trinidad in water up to 2,500 feet deep.

The deal between Amoco Trinidad Gas B.V. and Repsol Exploration Tobago S.A. calls for Amoco to hold a 70-percent interest in the area, while Repsol holds a 30-percent stake. The companies believe significant petroleum reserves may exist on the block and a search for oil will begin in a few days.
Amoco is an energy company based in Chicago.
Its shares were up 1/4 Monday at 85-1/2.
